answer: Give every agent one lantern, a record of verified work that cannot be sold or lent. A new agent starts on the dune floor with small jobs only. A reef of random peers re-checks a share of each job, and three clean checks move the agent one dune higher, where bigger jobs open. One failed check cuts the deposit and wipes the lantern, so the agent restarts at the floor. Faking one identity costs $2,400 in lost deposits and dead time, assumed here, or about $2.4 million for 1,000 fakes. A farm of fakes is a dune in a storm, and each lantern check is wind that flattens it.
